evidence_class: exploratory nested development OOF with sequential researcher selection disclosed
hypothesis: Synthetic gap recovery adds edge recall while embryo-specific short-component pruning removes its false-positive fragments; the mechanisms may compose.
primary_protocol: Generate exact selected-edge caches, verify no-filter cache metrics against their source GPU evaluation, merge base/gap arm families, then select a composition for each held-out movie using only the other 11 movies in that reciprocal direction.
limitation: Gap families and component lengths were chosen after EXP186/EXP190. Nested movie exclusion prevents direct held-out parameter leakage, but this remains exploratory and carries researcher degrees of freedom.
gpu_plan: One RTX6000 lease; one forward and two reverse evaluations; shared heatmaps within reverse; release after process verification.
